_about: Voice direction for Chatterbox (scripts/make_voice_cb.py). One entry per script LINE (split=line). Timbre: voice B (bm_george reference).

lines.say: In nineteen ninety-eight, a fund packed with geniuses lost four point six billion dollars in four months. Two of them had Nobel Prizes.
lines.note: hook: storyteller, weight on 'four point six billion', then 'Nobel Prizes' dry
explainer, clear, 'tiny price gap' small and precise
'Like picking up nickels.' light, then 'A lot.' guilty deadpan

lines.say: For every dollar they owned, they borrowed twenty-five.
It worked. Over forty percent a year. Banks begged to lend them more.
Then, in August, nineteen ninety-eight, Russia defaulted on its debt.

lines.note: 'nearly impossible' dry; then fast panic on 'ran to safe bonds'

lines.say: Borrowing twenty-five times means every loss hits twenty-five times harder.
The Federal Reserve called the big banks. Fourteen of them paid about three point six five billion dollars, to stop a crash.
Remember Ed Thorp? Same maths, but he sized every bet so one bad night couldn't wipe him out.
